Sheetal-Toman and Swati win historic medals at World Championships

The Sheetal-Toman pair won a gold medal, while Swati secured a historic medal at the World Championships. Swati's achievement marks India's first medal in the W1 category. Sheetal also achieved a double gold, matching her previous tally from the Hangzhou games.
